mapper.sql: f.id AS food_id, f.name AS food_name, f.latitude, f.longitude, f.address, f.summary, f.story, f.ingredients, f.image_url, f.heat, f.review_status, f.reviewed_by, f.reviewed_at, f.created_by, f.created_at, r.id AS region_id, r.name AS region_name, r.province AS region_province, r.description AS region_description
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM food f INNER JOIN region r ON r.id = f.region_id
f.review_status = 'APPROVED'
AND LOWER(f.name) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{keyword}), '%')
AND f.region_id = #{regionId}
ORDER BY f.heat DESC, f.id DESC
SELECT FROM food f INNER JOIN region r ON r.id = f.region_id ORDER BY FIELD(f.review_status, 'PENDING', 'APPROVED', 'REJECTED'), f.id DESC
SELECT FROM food f INNER JOIN region r ON r.id = f.region_id WHERE f.id = #{id} AND f.review_status = 'APPROVED'
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO food_daily_visit (food_id, user_id, visit_date, visited_at) SELECT f.id, u.id, CURRENT_DATE, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM food f INNER JOIN app_user u ON u.username = #{username} AND u.active = TRUE WHERE f.id = #{foodId} AND f.review_status = 'APPROVED'
mapper.update: UPDATE food SET review_status = #{status}, reviewed_by = #{reviewedBy}, reviewed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND review_status = 'PENDING'
